caption: The drawing depicts two silver-colored ladles of different sizes placed diagonally across an off-white background. Both ladles have a curved handle ending in a broad, rounded tip; on each tip, the words "A Mothers token" are inscribed in cursive text. The larger ladle is positioned above and to the left of the smaller one, with both bowls tilted at a slight angle, revealing the reflective interior surfaces, which show diffused window-shaped reflections. The handles have a gentle curve and subtle contour details, and the drawing uses a range of gray shading to suggest the metallic texture and highlights of the ladles. There is no additional decorative element, background, or context other than the plain backdrop.
title: Spoon
